config.notes: Apex Australia (vet.apexaustralia.edu.au/courses/<slug>), one course per page, server-rendered text. Key facts: 'CRICOS Course Code: <code> ... Quick Details Study mode X Campus locations Y Course duration N weeks Full-Time Course Fees ...'; lower down 'Course Duration and Delivery N Weeks ... Course Fees Tuition Fee: $T * Enrolment Fee ... Resources Fee ...'. Tuition Fee is a whole-course figure with no international label (page says it is for domestic and international students) and for most courses it disagrees with the CRICOS register total, so fee_total and course_years are read for review only and the fee is not admitted (fee rule 7). General English prints $290 per week (not read). English: 'IELTS 6.0 or equivalent' in Entry Requirements on VET pages (not on General English or EAP). Delivery: 'Face-to-Face' (General English) or 'Blended (face-to-face and online)' (VET); blended is a required mix, so delivery is not admitted unless the reader understands it. Intakes: the page prints only stale dates ('Intake Dates 12 Aug 2024 ... 14 Apr 2025 View More 12 July 2021') or a hidden 'View Intakes' panel, so no intakes pattern; the general reader's July is stale and must not be admitted. Nine other bound pages failed to fetch (evidence kept, not read).
